title: "Advanced usage"
description: "Options, S3 dispatch and the things you reach for second."
---

A `.qmd` article, to prove the pipeline does not care which extension it gets.
It carries no `vignette:` block, so it is an article rather than a registered
vignette -- which is exactly how Quarto-only documents usually appear.

## Options

```{r}
library(testpkg.full)
str(full_config(digits = 5))
```

## Dispatch

`full_describe()` is generic:

```{r}
full_describe(1:5)
full_describe("a")
```

## A table

| Function | Operation |
| --- | --- |
| `full_add()` | `x + y` |
| `full_experimental()` | `x * 2` |
